1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the State.
2.

The present application has been filed by applicants for quashing the Non-Bailable Warrant/ 82 Cr.P.C. dated 04.04.2025 and cognizance order dated 22.08.2003 and charge sheet dated 11.08.2003 as well as entire criminal proceedings of Case No. 12922 of 2014 arising out of Case Crime No. 06 of 2003 (State Vs. Braj Mohan and others) under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kotwali District Ghaziabad pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial -Magistrate, Court No.6, Ghaziabad on the ground that opposite party no.2 has obtained divorce from applicant no.1 under Section 13 B of Hindu Marriage Act on 20.12.2016 but the said proceeding was not on record and against applicants non bailable warrant /82 proceedings i.e. coercive in nature has been initiated.

sentences.text: 4. Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.
5. Under the circumstances, the present application under Section 528 BNSS is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicants to approach the court concerned for bail.
In order to enable the applicants to approach the court concerned for bail, for a period of 20 days, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
In case, the bail application is preferred by the applicants before the court concerned, the court concerned shall decide the same expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to any party.
6. The application under Section 528 BNSS is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty and direction.
